mina: Heads-up 1: my neighbor is swinging by at 3:15 with a tiny cactus, two helium balloons, and a folded stroller. Also might be a small brown parcel for me today  Can you hold it and print a guest badge?
front-desk: All good. Guests get a day badge and sign-in. Balloons = lobby-only, please. We can hold parcels in locker H2. Which name for the badge?
mina: Badge for 'Samir Patel'. Parcel likely addressed to Mina Kaur. Please add 'Fragile' if it's marked.
reception-bot: Guest badge queued for "Samir Patel" at 15:08. Badge ID: G-8502.
chris: Quick FYI 1: if the stroller is folded it's okay in the main elevator but during peak we ask to wait for the freight. I can meet at 15:10 to help.
mailroom: Update: small box for Mina Kaur arrived at 14:52, labelled "kitchen towel". No damage, placed in H2. No odd smells.
mina: Thanks! Could you also put a sticky "do not place on mail shelf" on the box? It's fabric and might snag on the hooks.
front-desk: Sticky note "Do not place on mail shelf" added. We'll ring x1400 when guest checks in. Also mat and plug extension available at east window.
facilities: Heads-up 1: we'll move a small side table by the east window if you want a plant-safe spot. ETA 5 mins.
chris: I'm here at 15:12 to help with stroller/elevator if needed.
mina: Awesome, thank you all :)
front-desk: Guest checked in at 15:16. Badge handed to Samir. Parcel in H2, sticky attached. Balloons clipped at lobby post.
mailroom: Closing loop: parcel handed to Mina at 15:22 after ID check. No issues.
mina: Huge thanks, everyone 
4 You're lifesavers — plant and balloons are safe and stroller folded. See you later!"
